name: Osteochondritis Dissecans of the Knee
definition: Focal subchondral bone and overlying cartilage disorder, most often affecting the femoral condyle in adolescents or young adults.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and MRI assess lesion stability and healing potential.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Activity restriction for stable juvenile lesions
amber: Unstable lesions may require drilling, fixation or cartilage restoration.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu Asthi-Sandhi lesion may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Focal subchondral bone and overlying cartilage disorder, most often affecting the femoral condyle in adolescents or young adults.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
